title: Dutch Parliamentary Election Study 2017-2021 (DPES/NKO 2017-2021), 6 waves panel data
descriptions: This panel data set covers 6 waves capped by the Dutch parliamentary elections (Tweede Kamerverkiezingen) of 2017 and 2021. It contains a range of variables common to the regular DPES, including reported voting behavior in 2017 (Lower House), 2019 (provincial), 2019 (European Parliament) and 2021 (Lower House). Data were collected via the LISS-panel of Centerdata, and can be enriched with additional data from that panel. To make use of these data users need to register with Centerdata.
